question: Will BTC/USDT close above 81,000 USDT on the Binance daily candle closing at 00:00 UTC on Aug 28, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT daily candle on Binance closes strictly above 81,000 USDT at 00:00 UTC on Aug 28, 2026 (i.e., the Aug 27 UTC daily close).
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT daily candle on Binance closes at or below 81,000 USDT at 00:00 UTC on Aug 28, 2026.
